identity.affine_arithmetic: Arb encloses c0+exact_delta*v and alpha0+exact_delta*w before all fixed base weights
identity.parameter_arithmetic: First form complete exact center and direction scalar polynomials; then add the single p in [-eta,eta]. No independent raw-control parameter intervals are introduced.
identity.exact_delta_fraction_scope: The exact_delta_fraction field names the center only; all bounds cover the separately stated whole exact_parameter_interval.

pieces.first_moment_method: W1 <= min(Bhalf/sqrt(5), derivative_Ahalf/(sqrt(5)-1)); physical nonzero frequencies >=4; minimum with complete actual rectangle A1 when provided
pieces.source_space: L2(dr; H^(1/2) f0 direct_sum H^(3/2) fr direct_sum H^(3/2) ftheta), physical weights max(1,4|k|)^s

alpha.conversion: ||f||max <= ||f||Bessel <= (17/16)**(s/2)||f||max; one such factor suffices for the converted multiplier bound

v.conversion: ||f||max <= ||f||Bessel <= (17/16)**(s/2)||f||max; one such factor suffices for the converted multiplier bound

kernel_contract.physical_derivative: Dtheta, frequencies 4k; mean weight exactly one
kernel_contract.commutator: [J,a] <= O + (4/sqrt(pi))*sqrt(O*||Dtheta a||infty), O=||a-a_c||infty for the saved chosen constant
kernel_contract.second_derivative_gap: finite theta3 times the closed-cell half gap plus the entire already-paid true theta2 error; no infinite theta3 assertion
kernel_contract.scope: full radial interval, full physical circle and whole real parameter interval of the original coefficient certificate

forward.identity: (sqrt(E0),sqrt(Ehalf)) obeys the ordered positive triangular comparison; the source vector is an L2 radial bound in the stated common strong-source space

backward.identity: (sqrt(E0),sqrt(Ehalf)) obeys the ordered positive triangular comparison; the source vector is an L2 radial bound in the stated common strong-source space

forward.kernel_rule: For a complete five-column source Gram G=integral F*F in the stated product space, the zero-initial endpoint energy E_j is at most kernel_j^2 times G as a quadratic form. Every radial piece, source seam and canonical/root conversion remains subject to its separate actual contract.

backward.kernel_rule: For a complete five-column source Gram G=integral F*F in the stated product space, the zero-initial endpoint energy E_j is at most kernel_j^2 times G as a quadratic form. Every radial piece, source seam and canonical/root conversion remains subject to its separate actual contract.

exact_source_convention: f0=-R0, fr=Rr, ftheta=Rtheta; shifted momentum pbar=p_N, unchanged from R107/R110
scope: Only the declared contiguous, genuinely strict-negative intervals and the entire actual real parameter interval.
The complete zero-order and high-coefficient commutators are retained as base-energy forcing, not omitted.
The new full periodic kernel bounds are minimized against, and never subtracted from, the original complete Fourier budgets.
No maximum frequency cutoff enters the tame Fourier inequalities.
The original full physical PDE, not the saved projected Galerkin ODE, is estimated.
Root/Airy transfer, positive collars, cap feedback, frame conversion and nonlinear convergence are not supplied by this budget.
